purpose: Prove one real local ComfyUI generation before any orchestration promotion

checkpoint.selection_rule: Read the exact installed checkpoint filename and SHA-256 from the local probe; do not guess or download a replacement.

preflight: an existing repo Python runtime exists
at least one checkpoint is enumerated with exact filename, size and SHA-256
port 8188 health state is recorded before start

generation.positive_prompt: documentary photograph of a weathered wooden chair in an empty sunlit community hall, natural light, realistic texture
generation.negative_prompt: text, watermark, logo, duplicate objects, malformed geometry

required_evidence: media receipt JSON validated against contracts/media-receipt.schema.json
pass_conditions: existing ComfyUI process becomes healthy or is already healthy
exact enumerated checkpoint loads without fallback substitution
receipt status is succeeded and QA is not_run or pass
promotion_rule: Do not add n8n, custom nodes, SDXL, video diffusion, batch generation, reinstall ComfyUI, or download a replacement checkpoint until this existing-install canary passes repeatedly.
